articles.title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
articles.snippet: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

articles.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
articles.snippet: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.

articles.title: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t
articles.snippet: Staff guidance lets swap venues and clearinghouses count Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins toward their 12-month operating-cost buffer. Here's the catch.
